findings.evidence: Model.lean:32/142/181 put the ambient declarations (`euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv`, `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam`, `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj`) in `namespace TauCeti` (Model.lean:27), while `namespace EuclideanHalfSpace` (Model.lean:274-341) contains only half-space-typed declarations (`boundaryParam`, `boundaryProj`, `boundaryProj_coe`, …). `collarAmbientEquiv : (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))` breaks that split.
findings.fix: Move the three declarations to the root `TauCeti` namespace and name them after their content, e.g. `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalProdEquiv` (the `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)`-valued variant of `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv`), with matching `_apply_zero`/`_apply_succ` lemmas.
findings.issue: `collarAmbientEquiv` (and its lemmas `collarAmbientEquiv_apply_zero`, line 65, and `collarAmbientEquiv_apply_succ`, line 71) is in namespace `TauCeti.EuclideanHalfSpace` but its statement mentions no `EuclideanHalfSpace` at all — it is a pure ambient-Euclidean coordinate splitting. It is also named after its downstream client ("collar") rather than after what it is.

findings.evidence: Collar.lean:122 `(collarHomeomorph n p).1 0 = p.2.1 0` vs Collar.lean:148 `collarHomeomorph n (x, (0 : EuclideanHalfSpace 1)) = boundaryParam n x`; the naming guide requires the name to describe the conclusion, and Model.lean:291 uses `_coe` for the `Subtype.val` step (`boundaryParam_coe`).
findings.fix: Name these after their conclusion, e.g. `collarHomeomorph_apply_zero_eq_boundaryParam` / `collarDiffeomorph_apply_zero_eq_boundaryParam` (or `..._boundaryParam` following `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj_param`, Model.lean:225). Optionally rename the coordinate-index family to `_apply_coe_zero`/`_apply_coe_succ`, since their LHS is `(f p).1 i`, a `Subtype.val` coercion.
findings.issue: `collarHomeomorph_apply_zero_normal` reads as a refinement of `collarHomeomorph_apply_zero` (line 120), but in the latter `zero` is the output coordinate index while here it is the input argument; the name also says nothing about the conclusion `= boundaryParam n x`. Same collision at `collarDiffeomorph_apply_zero` (line 217) vs `collarDiffeomorph_apply_zero_normal` (line 247).

summary: Two naming issues: an ambient-Euclidean equivalence placed in the `EuclideanHalfSpace` namespace against the convention Model.lean establishes, and a `_apply_zero_normal` name that reads as a specialization of the unrelated `_apply_zero` lemma while failing to describe its conclusion.
